Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.config_profile.count
Metrics.Description: Intune device configuration profile inventory, by configuration type (excludes Windows Update ring profiles, owned by the update-rings collector).

Metrics.Name: intune.config_profile.status
Metrics.Description: Per-profile Intune device configuration deployment status, by profile and state.

Metrics.Name: intune.config_profile.version
Metrics.Description: Configured version of each Intune device configuration profile; a bump signals a profile-content change.
